li.label: a god's beast died
li.description: One of our animals that I held to be sacred has died. It feels like more than losing an animal.

li.label: a sacred beast slain
li.description: We killed a beast I believe was sacred. I don't think that kind of thing goes unanswered.

li.label: the beast left be
li.description: The council left the beast alone, as I asked. It isn't ours to hunt, and now everyone knows it.

plain.li: [greet] Hello, {BEAST}, you're one of {GOD}'s, aren't you.
[greet] So you're {GOD}'s own, welcome to the colony.
[greet] Look at you, {BEAST}, {GOD} must have sent you to us.
[greet,cirrus] You smell like a storm coming, {BEAST}, {GOD} must be fond of you.
[greet,undertow] You only come out at dusk, {BEAST}, just like {GOD}'s own should.
[greet,hollin] There's moss in your coat, {BEAST}, {GOD} keeps you close.
[greet,hush] So cold to the touch, {BEAST}, you're {GOD}'s for sure.
[greet,helios] You shine in the sun, {BEAST}, {GOD} must have made you on a bright day.
[greet,selene] You keep the night hours, {BEAST}, like {GOD} does.
[greet,smoulder] You're warm as a hearthstone, {BEAST}, {GOD} must be close under you.
[greet,morel] You smell of the forest floor, {BEAST}, that's {GOD} in you.
[bite] Here, {BEAST}, a bite from my hand for {GOD}'s sake.
[bite] Go on, take it, it's for you.
[bite,nofood] I've nothing for you today, {BEAST}, but I came to see you.
[festivalbite] You eat first today, {BEAST}, it's {GOD}'s day.
[festivalbite] First bite of the feast is yours, {BEAST}.
[festivalbite,nofood] There's nothing in the stores for you, {BEAST}, but you come with me today.
[shrine] Stand here with me a moment, {BEAST}, it's your day as well.
[gone] {BEAST} was one of {GOD}'s, and I hope it's gone back to them.
[gone] Rest now, {BEAST}, {GOD} will have you back.
[resident] That {KIND} out there is {GOD}'s, nobody touch it.
[resident] Don't anyone hunt that {KIND}, it belongs to {GOD}.
[resident] {BEAST} is {GOD}'s, I knew it the first time I saw it.
[legend] That's {GOD}'s own creature, I'd know it anywhere.
[legend] Look at it, that's no ordinary {KIND}, it belongs to {GOD}.
[legend] {GOD} has sent one of their own across our land.
[legendunnamed] That's no ordinary {KIND}, something sent it here.
[legendunnamed] I don't know whose it is, but that {KIND} is holy.
[legendscoff] It's a rare {KIND}, that's all it is.
